authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner’s first aṅguli branch gives Punjabi aṅgul/uṅgul, Gujarati ā̃gḷī, Bengali āṅul and Nepali aũli with compound amal-. These survey finger forms fit that branch, including the contracted western āŋgu and Majhi amuli; the aṅgula measure-of-length entry (134) and Dardic aṅgūḍi branch are excluded. Hajong final n and Vasavi aspiration are retained as regional qualifications.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Hindi/Western Pahari gāt body, Nepali gāth person/body and Bengali gā body under gātra. The Haryanvi gāṭ, Gujari gāth and Bengali ga responses fit these regional shapes. The short responses are not assigned to the separate gātraka family with an additional suffix.
